page.title: Galleries
page.subtitle: Named collections of pictures: events, teams, projects…

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, manager or description...

states.emptyDescription: Try a different tab, search or filter.
states.forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view this screen.
states.notFound: This gallery no longer exists or isn't available to you.

imageStates.emptyDescription: Pictures you add to this gallery appear here.

upload.limit: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF · up to {{size}}

problem.extension: Only JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF pictures are accepted.
problem.tooLarge: The picture is larger than 10 MB.

form.createSubtitle: Describe the gallery and add its first pictures.
form.editSubtitle: Saving replaces every field: anything you clear is removed. Pictures are not touched.
form.name: Name
form.periodHint: Optional. The date the gallery is about.
form.imagesHint: Optional. Each picture uploads as soon as you choose it; everything is saved together, and if one is refused none is created.
form.noImagesYet: No pictures yet. You can also add them later from the gallery page.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can't be longer than 5000 characters.
errors.managerTooLong: The manager name can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.uploadPending: Wait for the upload to finish.
errors.imageTitleTooLong: The title can't be longer than 255 characters.
errors.generic: The gallery could not be saved. Try again.

addImages.title: Add pictures
addImages.description: Up to 20 pictures at once. If one is refused, none is added.

editImage.title: Edit picture
editImage.description: Change the title or replace the picture.
editImage.fileHint: Optional. A refused file changes nothing.

delete.title: Move to trash?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be moved to the trash. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore gallery?
restore.description: “{{name}}” will be brought back from the trash.

force_delete.title: Delete permanently?
force_delete.description: “{{name}}” and ALL its pictures, including trashed ones, and their stored files will be removed for good. This can't be undone.

delete.title: Move picture to trash?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be moved to the trash. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore picture?
restore.description: “{{name}}” will be brought back from the trash.

force_delete.title: Delete picture permanently?
force_delete.description: “{{name}}” and its stored file will be removed for good. This can't be undone.

delete.title: Move {{count}} galleries to the trash?
delete.description: If any selected gallery can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

restore.title: Restore {{count}} galleries?
restore.description: If any selected gallery can't be restored, nothing is changed.

force_delete.title: Permanently delete {{count}} galleries?
force_delete.description: Their pictures and stored files are removed for good and this can't be undone. If any can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

delete.title: Move {{count}} pictures to the trash?
delete.description: If any selected picture can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

restore.title: Restore {{count}} pictures?
restore.description: If any selected picture can't be restored, nothing is changed.

force_delete.title: Permanently delete {{count}} pictures?
force_delete.description: Their stored files are removed for good and this can't be undone. If any can't be deleted, nothing is changed.

notice.notFound: That item no longer exists or isn't available to you. The data was refreshed.
notice.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
